definitions.explanation: A machine for purchasing tickets, commonly found at train stations and restaurants.

examples.japanese: {券売機|けんばいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy a ticket at the ticket machine.

examples.japanese: {券売機|けんばいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧です。
examples.english: The ticket machine accepts cash only.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{券売機|けんばいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食券|しょっけん}→食券：19934_shokken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a meal ticket at the ramen shop's ticket machine.

notes:
{券売機|けんばいき} is a ticket vending machine found throughout Japan, especially at train stations and many restaurants.

FORMS:
⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket) + {売|ばい} (sell) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine).

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧: train stations (for ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧ and IC card top-ups)
- ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: ramen shops (order and pay before sitting)
- ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧: cafeterias and casual restaurants

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {券売機|けんばいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at the ticket machine
- {券売機|けんばいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食券|しょっけん}→食券：19934_shokken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a meal ticket

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧: ticket
- ⟦{食券|しょっけん}→食券：19934_shokken⟧: meal ticket
- ⟦{精算機|せいさんき}→精算機：10189_seisanki⟧: fare adjustment machine
